When Does the NFL London Game 2026 Start ?

The NFL London Game happens on Sunday (Oct. 4) with a matchup featuring the Indianapolis Colts (1-2) taking on the Washington Commanders (1-2) at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium in London, England, with a start time of 9:30 a.m. ET/6:30 a.m. PT.

What TV Network Features the NFL London Game 2026?

The Colts-Commanders game broadcasts on NFL Network, while the NFL game is available to livestream on ESPN Unlimited .

Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances During the NFL London Game 2026?

NFL games are known for celebrity sightings, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance. Artists have been known to appear at games in the past, include English NFL fans, Idris Elba, Kit Harington, Prince William and others.

In addition, R&B singer and former-contestant on The Voice , Jordyn Simone performs “The Star-Spangled Banner,” while English pop star Mimi Webb performs “God Save the King,” ahead of kickoff.
